parent_objective: audit M1534 history-intervention smoke before any candidate materialization or self-ID claim
blocked_by: M1534 produced positive wrong-history and donor-response gaps that need audit before any stronger claim
supersedes: direct self-ID claim from implementation smoke

public_gates: M1535 must audit wrong-history donor-response reset and zero-current channels separately
M1535 must decide whether candidate materialization remains blocked
M1535 must not claim level3 self-ID from source-small public smoke
M1535 must choose next route: repeat/source expansion/pair repair/materialization design
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run new interventions during audit
do not claim level3 self-identification from M1534 alone

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M1534 positive bounded history-intervention smoke and selects the next evidence step
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no candidate materialization, new intervention run, training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, paper-level or level3 self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if audit overclaims source-small public positive smoke
stop if audit collapses reset/zero-current into self-ID evidence
stop if audit routes directly to training or promotion
fallback_plan: route to source-expanded repeat if evidence is promising but too small
route to pair repair if positives are dominated by reset/zero-current
route to materialization design only if audit justifies it without self-ID overclaim

admission_evidence: M1534 ran bounded wrong-history and donor-response interventions over accepted measured pairs
blocked_shortcuts: do not run new interventions in audit
allowed_updates: status queue scoreboard research log and review

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1535 must audit whether reset/zero-current controls dominate M1534 effects before any self-ID claim.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1534 bounded public intervention smoke only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If positives are too source-small or dominated by controls, route to repeat/source expansion or pair repair instead of materialization.
allowed_claims: no promotion, corpus export, training, PPO, private-holdout, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1534 provides promising but source-small wrong-history and donor-response evidence that should route to audited repeat or expansion rather than direct self-ID claims.
success_criteria: audit reports wrong-history donor-response reset zero-current success-drop guardrail and source-size metrics
audit explicitly decides whether materialization remains blocked
audit routes to one follow-up repeat source-expansion pair-repair or materialization-design manifest
candidate materialization training PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes and corpus export remain blocked unless a design-only follow-up is justified
failure_criteria: audit routes directly to training promotion or private holdout
audit claims level3 self-identification from M1534 alone
decision_rule: M1535 passes if it audits M1534 and chooses the next evidence route without overclaiming or materializing candidates.
